candidates.name: Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C)
support_spans: High-grade fever for 14 days
Bilateral non-purulent conjunctivitis
Glasgow Coma Score: 11
CRP: 64.9 mg/L
Ferritin: 614.6 ng/L
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with high-grade fever, conjunctivitis, and elevated inflammatory markers such as CRP and ferritin is consistent with MIS-C.

candidates.name: Acute Hemorrhagic Leukoencephalitis (AHLE)
support_spans: Progressive weakness on the right side of body for 5 days
Upper motor neuron type right-sided seventh cranial-nerve palsy
Complete hemiplegia
Multifocal discrete and confluent hypodensities in genu and adjacent body of corpus callosum, left basal ganglia, and bilateral thalami
candidates.why: The patient's neurological symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with AHLE, a rare and severe form of encephalitis.

candidates.name: Cerebral Vasculitis

Diffuse narrowing of M2 and M3 segment branches of both middle cerebral arteries
candidates.why: The patient's imaging findings are consistent with cerebral vasculitis, although the vasculitis profile is negative.
